title: Relationship Desk Card: Lease Lateness and the Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Catch-Up Pull-Ahead
content:
**Relationship desk card — retail customers who also lease from Kestrel.** Late charges on the customer's Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease raise the pull-ahead share of a catch-up payment on the customer's Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.

**Rule.** When the customer's Kestrel lease ledger shows a lease late charge in the last 3 calendar months, 20 percentage points are added to the pull-ahead share; when it shows a lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months but none in the last 3 calendar months, 10 points are added; in every other case nothing is added to it.

The lease ledger read is that of the customer's Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease; the lease need not be active. The points are added to the pull-ahead share that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to one monthly payment.

| Latest lease late charge on the customer's lease ledger | Points added to the pull-ahead share |
|---|---|
| within the last 3 calendar months | 20 |
| within the last 12 calendar months, but not the last 3 | 10 |
| none within the last 12 calendar months | 0 |

**Counting.** Lease late charges are the lease late charge entries on the customer's Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease ledger, by their dates. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical):* today the 25th; a lease late charge dated the 26th of the month three months back lies within the last 3 calendar months (20 points); one dated the 25th of that month does not, but lies within the last 12 (10 points).
